title: The suite's rag.py eval rebuilds the pack index only for what an edit changed
goal: After an edit to one kb article, or to _tools/kbfacts.py that leaves INDEX_VERSION unchanged, the next rag.py pack or eval on the Windows host reuses the index for unchanged content instead of a full 14-22 s rebuild, while every changed fact is still found; measured before and after on that host.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,os,shutil;t=tempfile.mkdtemp();d=os.path.join(t,'wt');s.run(['git','worktree','add','-q','--detach',d],check=True);e={**os.environ,'KB_INDEX':os.path.join(t,'ix')};rag=os.path.join(d,'_tools','rag.py');run=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,rag,*a],cwd=d,env=e,capture_output=True,text=True);tm=lambda *a:(lambda t0:(run(*a),time.time()-t0)[1])(time.time());cold=tm('pack','kerberos delegation');open(os.path.join(d,'kb','public','windows','process-parent-and-command-line.md'),'a',encoding='utf-8').write('\n- The plantedzzqx7 marker is a planted fact for a test. [DOC S-u6fzpqel]\n');after=tm('pack','kerberos delegation');hit=run('search','plantedzzqx7');found='plantedzzqx7' in hit.stdout;shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);s.run(['git','worktree','prune']);print('cold',round(cold,2),'after edit',round(after,2),'planted word found',found);sys.exit(0 if (found and after<=0.5*cold) else 1)

gates.question: Is this item worked and proven on the project's Windows 11 host?

notes: ST-4mcoplex (done 2026-10-07, SP-eahtellz) delivered the content-keyed index this builds on. Premise (macOS, 2026-10-07): with an isolated KB_INDEX a cold rag.py pack took 3.18 s and the pack after one planted article line 3.08 s, so the rebuild is full on every host; the check asks for at most half the cold time and the planted line found by rag.py search. The Windows before and after figures (cold 12.8-14.3 s, test-suite-speed.md) are measured on the host and written to that report. Premise on the Windows host (2026-10-08, origin/main d5a26e12): the check exits 1, cold 14.98 s, after one planted article line 10.52 s (70% of cold, target at most 50%), planted word found.
